units.source_text: “回家后，我跟夫人和小姐说了这件事。

en.t: After I returned home, I told the lady of the house and her daughter about it.

units.source_text: 夫人笑了，看着我的脸，说：‘一定让你为难了吧。’

en.t: The lady smiled, looked at my face, and said, 'That must have put you in a difficult position.'

units.source_text: 当时我暗想，男人就是这样被女人刺探心思的吗？

en.t: At the time I wondered inwardly whether this was how women probed the minds of men.

units.source_text: 因为夫人的眼神足以使我这样想。

en.t: For the look in the lady's eyes was enough to make me think so.

units.source_text: 也许当时我直截了当地把自己的想法说出来就好了。

en.t: Perhaps it would have been better if I had frankly said what I was thinking then.

units.source_text: 但是，一些疑神疑鬼的念头已盘踞在我心里。

en.t: But certain suspicious thoughts had already taken hold in my heart.

units.source_text: 我刚想说出来，又突然收住，故意岔开了话题。

en.t: Just as I was about to speak, I suddenly stopped myself and deliberately changed the subject.

units.source_text: 我把自己这个关键的当事人从谈话中抽出，探问夫人对小姐婚姻问题的态度。

en.t: I removed myself, the central person concerned, from the conversation and sounded out the lady's attitude toward her daughter's marriage.

units.source_text: 夫人告诉我，来提亲的倒是有过两三个，

en.t: The lady told me that there had in fact been two or three proposals of marriage,

units.source_text: 但她又解释道，小姐还在上学，考虑此事尚早，所以她也不那么着急。

en.t: but she explained that her daughter was still in school and it was too early to consider such matters, so she was not in any great hurry.

units.source_text: 虽然夫人嘴上没说，我却看得出她对小姐的容貌很有自信。

en.t: Although the lady did not say so aloud, I could see that she had great confidence in her daughter's looks.

units.source_text: 她甚至还流露出，想要定亲的话，随时都可以定下来。

en.t: She even let it be known that, if they wished to settle an engagement, it could be settled at any time.

units.source_text: 再说，夫人只有小姐一个孩子，这也是不会随便把她嫁出去的原因之一。

en.t: Besides, the daughter was the lady's only child, and that was one reason she would not casually marry her off.

units.source_text: 据我判断，就连是把小姐嫁出去，还是招婿进门，夫人都还在犹豫之中。

en.t: As I judged it, the lady was still undecided even about whether to marry her daughter out or take a son-in-law into the household.

units.source_text: 和夫人的谈话使我觉得增长了许多见识，

en.t: My conversation with the lady made me feel that I had learned a great deal,

units.source_text: 而也因此错失了良机，我始终都没能开口提及自己的想法。

en.t: but because of that I also missed my chance, and in the end I was never able to bring myself to speak of my own thoughts.

units.source_text: 估摸着告一段落的时候，我打住话头，准备回自己的房间。

en.t: When I judged that the conversation had reached a suitable pause, I brought it to an end and prepared to return to my room.
